title: pricesensitivitymeter (R package)
author_source: Max Alletsee, CRAN, v1.3.3 (2025-08-30), MIT licence, R, package
note: Implements the Van Westendorp Price Sensitivity Meter incl. the Newton-Miller-Smith extension (purchase-probability calibration, trial- and revenue-optimal price). psm_analysis() returns optimal price point, indifference price point and range of acceptable prices; psm_plot() draws the four-curve chart; psm_analysis_weighted() handles survey weights. Vignettes on small-sample interpolation and visualisation.
course_use: Lab: students answer the four VW questions in class (e.g. streaming or coffee subscription) and compute OPP/IPP/RAP in R within 30 minutes. Free, open licence.

title: pricesensitivitymeter source repository
author_source: max-alletsee, GitHub, active 2025, MIT, R, package source
note: Source code, issues and examples for the CRAN package; shows how the NMS extension computes trial and revenue curves.
course_use: Instructor reference; advanced students reading the implementation. Free.

title: logitr (R package) - logit in WTP space
author_source: John Helveston, CRAN, v1.2.0 (2026-07-06), MIT, R, package
note: Fast multinomial and mixed logit in preference space or directly in willingness-to-pay space (scalePar = 'price'), so coefficients are WTP in currency units. Functions logitr(), wtp(), predict(); multistart for non-convex WTP-space models. Vignettes use the bundled yogurt and cars_us data.
course_use: Core conjoint-WTP lab: estimate a preference-space MNL, convert with wtp(), re-estimate in WTP space and compare. Pairs with cbcTools for design. Free.

title: cbcTools (R package) - choice-based conjoint design and power
author_source: John Helveston, CRAN/GitHub, 2024-2025, MIT, R, package
note: Builds profiles, randomised or D-efficient CBC designs (cbc_design), simulates choices (cbc_choices) and runs power analyses (cbc_power) to set sample size before fielding a conjoint with price as an attribute.
course_use: Lab: design a 4-attribute CBC with price levels, simulate respondents, show how the price coefficient's standard error shrinks with n. Free.

title: bayesm (R package)
author_source: Peter Rossi, CRAN, v3.1-7 (2025-11-11), GPL (>=2), R, package
note: Bayesian marketing models from Rossi, Allenby and McCulloch (2005): rhierMnlRwMixture() for hierarchical-Bayes MNL (individual part-worths and WTP distributions), rmnpGibbs, rhierLinearModel. Ships camera, margarine, orangeJuice, cheese, tuna datasets.
course_use: Advanced lab: HB estimation on camera conjoint, individual WTP for features, heterogeneity histograms. Free; computationally heavier.

title: mlogit (R package)
author_source: Yves Croissant, CRAN, v1.1-x (2024-2025), GPL (>=2), R, package
note: Multinomial, nested, mixed and probit logit with dfidx data. Ships Catsup, Cracker, Heating, Electricity, Train; vignettes show WTP as coefficient ratios and mixed-logit WTP distributions.
course_use: Lab: Cracker or Catsup brand choice with price, display and feature; own- and cross-price elasticities via effects(). Free.

title: gmnl (R package)
author_source: Mauricio Sarrias and Ricardo Daziano, CRAN, v1.1-x, GPL (>=2), R, package
note: Generalized MNL (scale heterogeneity), mixed and latent-class logit; WTP-space estimation. Shows taste vs scale heterogeneity in WTP.
course_use: Elective lab or thesis tool; latent-class WTP segments. Free; little maintenance since about 2020, check compatibility.

title: apollo (R package) - choice modelling
author_source: Stephane Hess and David Palma (Choice Modelling Centre, Leeds), CRAN, v0.3.9 (2026-07-13), GPL-2, R, package
note: MNL, nested, cross-nested, mixed, latent-class and hybrid choice models, Bayesian option; apollo_deltaMethod() gives WTP with delta-method standard errors. Large example library and manual at apollochoicemodelling.com.
course_use: Thesis and advanced lab: mixed-logit WTP with confidence intervals from a stated-choice study. Free; steeper learning curve.

title: conjoint (R package)
author_source: Andrzej Bak and Tomasz Bartlomowicz, CRAN, v1.41, GPL, R, package
note: Ratings-based full-profile conjoint: caModel(), caPartUtilities(), caImportance(), caSegmentation(). Ships the tea dataset (13 profiles, 100 respondents; price, variety, kind, aroma).
course_use: Intro lab: part-worths and attribute importance from tea data; discuss why price importance depends on level range. Free; check CRAN status before the course.

title: ChoiceModelR (R package)
author_source: Ryan Sermas, CRAN, v1.3, GPL-2, R, package
note: Hierarchical-Bayes MNL (choicemodelr()) mirroring Sawtooth CBC/HB; individual betas for WTP and market simulators.
course_use: Free alternative to Sawtooth CBC/HB in labs. Older, lightly maintained.

title: idefix (R package) - efficient DCE designs
author_source: Frits Traets, Daniel Gil and Martina Vandebroek, CRAN, v1.x, GPL-3, R, package
note: D-efficient and Bayesian-efficient designs (Modfed, CEA) for discrete choice experiments, adaptive sequential designs, Shiny survey app (SurveyApp).
course_use: Project: teams design a choice experiment with a price attribute and field it via the Shiny app. Free.

title: support.CEs (R package)
author_source: Hideo Aizaki, CRAN, GPL, R, package
note: Choice-experiment designs (rotation.design, Lma.design), questionnaire generation and marginal WTP via mwtp().
course_use: Lab from design to mwtp() in one session; suits students with limited R. Free.

title: AlgDesign (R package)
author_source: Bob Wheeler / Jerome Braun, CRAN, GPL (>=2), R, package
note: optFederov() for D-optimal fractional factorial designs; classic way to reduce conjoint profile sets.
course_use: Short demo on fractional factorial designs. Free.

title: xlogit (Python package)
author_source: Cristian Arteaga et al., PyPI, v0.2.7 (2023-07-25), MIT, Python, package
note: GPU-accelerated multinomial, conditional and mixed logit with panel data and Halton draws; no built-in WTP space, WTP computed as coefficient ratios.
course_use: Python-track lab: mixed logit on a CBC dataset, WTP distributions. Free; last release 2023.

title: Biogeme (Python package)
author_source: Michel Bierlaire, EPFL, PyPI / biogeme.epfl.ch, 3.x (2025), open source, Python, package
note: Maximum-likelihood logit, nested, cross-nested and mixed logit; examples on Swissmetro with WTP/value-of-time and simulation of shares under price changes.
course_use: Lab or thesis: value of time and price elasticities from Swissmetro. Free.

title: pylogit (Python package)
author_source: Timothy Brathwaite, GitHub/PyPI, BSD-3, Python, package
note: Conditional, nested, mixed and asymmetric logit in long format; Swissmetro notebooks. Largely unmaintained since about 2019.
course_use: Legacy option; prefer xlogit, Biogeme or choice-learn. Free.

title: choice-learn (Python package)
author_source: Artefact research (artefactory), PyPI, v1.3.3 (2026-05-28), MIT, Python, package
note: TensorFlow choice modelling: SimpleMNL, ConditionalLogit, NestedLogit, LatentClassConditionalLogit, RUMnet, TasteNet, plus assortment/pricing optimisation. Ships SwissMetro, ModeCanada, Train, Heating, Electricity, TaFeng grocery, Expedia ICDM-2013.
course_use: Lab: conditional logit on Expedia hotel choice, then price optimisation; bridge to ML. Free.

title: PyMC-Marketing (Python package)
author_source: PyMC Labs, PyPI, v1.2.0 (2026-09-29), Apache-2.0, Python, package
note: Bayesian MMM, CLV (BG/NBD, Gamma-Gamma), discrete choice (multinomial, nested, mixed logit), MaxDiff and Bayesian BLP for aggregate demand. No dedicated pricing module; elasticities derivable from choice/BLP models.
course_use: Advanced lab: Bayesian MNL for posterior WTP; BLP demo on market shares. Free.

title: statsmodels (Python) - log-log demand regression
author_source: statsmodels developers, PyPI, 0.14.x (2024-2025), BSD-3, Python, package
note: Formula API OLS/GLM (smf.ols('np.log(q) ~ np.log(p) + promo + C(store)')) for constant price elasticities with fixed effects and robust SE.
course_use: Lab: own-price elasticity on Dominick's or Kaggle retail data, then markup rule p = c*e/(1+e). Free.

title: EconML - causal price elasticity
author_source: Microsoft Research ALICE / py-why, GitHub/PyPI, 0.15.x (2024-2025), MIT, Python, package
note: Double machine learning (LinearDML, CausalForestDML) for heterogeneous price elasticities controlling for confounders; case-study notebook on orange juice pricing.
course_use: Advanced lab: naive OLS vs DML elasticity on OJ data; price endogeneity. Free.

title: DoWhy
author_source: py-why community, GitHub/PyPI, 0.12+ (2024-2025), MIT, Python, package
note: Causal workflow (model, identify, estimate, refute) with DAGs; frames price endogeneity before estimating elasticities.
course_use: Conceptual demo why price-demand correlations are not elasticities. Free.

title: SciPy optimize for price optimisation
author_source: SciPy developers, PyPI, 1.14+ (2025), BSD-3, Python, package
note: minimize_scalar / minimize with bounds and constraints to find profit-maximising prices from an estimated demand function (price ladders, margin floors).
course_use: Lab step after elasticity estimation; compare numeric optimum with Lerner rule. Free.

title: cvxgrp/elasticity-estimation
author_source: Stanford Convex Optimization Group, GitHub, 2026, Python, code
note: Estimates full own- and cross-price elasticity matrices with regularised convex optimisation; multi-product pricing.
course_use: Advanced demo or thesis starting point for assortment pricing. Free; check licence in repo.

title: Van Westendorp PSM notebook (vivianamarquez)
author_source: Viviana Marquez, GitHub, 2020, Python, notebook
note: Jupyter notebook computing the four VW cumulative curves and intersections with pandas/matplotlib from raw responses.
course_use: Python alternative for the VW lab; extend with NMS purchase-intent questions. Free.

title: Price elasticity estimation notebook (sumitdeole)
author_source: sumitdeole, GitHub, 2024, Python, notebook
note: E-commerce case estimating price elasticity of a fish product basket with OLS and instrumental variables, illustrating endogeneity.
course_use: Template for IV vs OLS lab. Free; student project, check code quality.

title: Conjoint analysis of WTP (jbonfardeci)
author_source: jbonfardeci, GitHub, 2021, notebook
note: Worked conjoint analysis converting part-worths to monetary willingness to pay.
course_use: Example for student term projects. Free; check licence.

title: Dynamic pricing with reinforcement learning (divdasani)
author_source: divdasani, GitHub, 2019, Python, thesis code
note: Single-agent dynamic pricing with RL in a simulated demand environment.
course_use: Revenue-management demo of exploration vs exploitation in price setting. Free; academic code.

title: Bandits with knapsacks dynamic pricing (Lunj12)
author_source: Lunj12, GitHub, 2018, Python, notebook
note: Dynamic pricing with limited inventory as a bandits-with-knapsacks problem; price experimentation algorithms.
course_use: Short demo linking price A/B tests with multi-armed bandits. Free.

title: Sawtooth Software Lighthouse Studio and Discover
author_source: Sawtooth Software, vendor, 2025/2026, commercial, Windows desktop (Lighthouse) / web (Discover), app
note: Industry standard for CBC, ACBC, MaxDiff with HB estimation and market simulators (WTP via share simulations). Academic programme: free classroom use of Discover; grants for master's (Discover) and PhD (Lighthouse Studio) students, non-commercial only.
course_use: Class demo or project: CBC with price in Discover, field to classmates, run simulator. Free for classroom/grant; commercial licences paid.

title: Conjointly
author_source: Conjointly, web SaaS, 2025/2026, commercial, app
note: Generic and brand-specific conjoint, Van Westendorp, Gabor-Granger, MaxDiff with automatic WTP and price-elasticity reports; extensive methodological guides.
course_use: Lab: set up Gabor-Granger and VW studies and compare outputs. Education/free tier with limits; paid plans.

title: Qualtrics Conjoint and Pricing Studies
author_source: Qualtrics XM, web, 2025/2026, commercial, app
note: Conjoint and MaxDiff project types with simulator; Van Westendorp and Gabor-Granger templates.
course_use: Survey fielding for projects; export data to R. Institutional licence (check WU access), login.

title: 1000minds
author_source: 1000minds Ltd, web, 2025/2026, commercial with free academic licences, app
note: PAPRIKA adaptive conjoint; part-worths and attribute WTP; free licences for teaching and research.
course_use: Classroom demo: adaptive conjoint on smartphone plans, results aggregated live. Free academic licence on application.

title: Displayr / Q Research Software
author_source: Displayr, web (Displayr) / desktop (Q), 2025/2026, commercial, app
note: Survey analysis with HB and latent-class choice models, conjoint simulators, Van Westendorp and Gabor-Granger templates; many free how-to articles.
course_use: No-code conjoint-to-simulator demo. Paid; trial and educational discounts.

title: SurveyMonkey and Alchemer pricing research tools
author_source: SurveyMonkey / Alchemer, web, 2025/2026, commercial, app
note: SurveyMonkey Market Research offers Van Westendorp and conjoint solutions; Alchemer has conjoint and MaxDiff question types.
course_use: Low-barrier fielding alternatives. Paid tiers needed for conjoint.

title: Price management suites: Pricefx, PROS, Zilliant, Vendavo
author_source: Pricefx, PROS Holdings, Zilliant, Vendavo, vendor SaaS, 2025/2026, commercial, enterprise apps
note: B2B price management: price waterfalls, deal guidance, AI price optimisation and elasticity models (PROS also airline revenue management). Vendor case studies and webinars.
course_use: Context for B2B pricing session or guest lecture; students compare vendor approaches. Enterprise licences, demos on request.

title: Competera and Prisync (retail competitive pricing)
author_source: Competera and Prisync, SaaS, 2025/2026, commercial, apps
note: Competera: demand-based retail price optimisation with elasticities and cross-elasticities; Prisync: competitor price tracking and repricing rules for e-commerce SMEs.
course_use: Demo of competitor-based vs value-based pricing tools. Paid; free trials.

title: Paddle / ProfitWell Metrics
author_source: Paddle (acquired ProfitWell 2022), SaaS, 2025/2026, freemium, app
note: Free subscription metrics (MRR, churn, ARPU); legacy Price Intelligently WTP research and SaaS pricing content.
course_use: Case input for SaaS pricing session (value metric, tiers). Metrics free; consulting paid.

title: Dominick's Finer Foods scanner data
author_source: James M. Kilts Center for Marketing, Chicago Booth, dataset, about 1989-1997, academic-use terms
note: Store-week-UPC movement data for about 100 Chicago stores and 29 categories (beer, cereals, canned tuna, refrigerated juices, etc.): price, units, profit margin, deal code; UPC files, daily customer counts, 1990 census store demographics. CSV and SAS; acknowledgement required.
course_use: Lab: log-log elasticity for a category with store fixed effects, promotion and cross-price effects; optimal prices. Free for academic use, no login.

title: NielsenIQ Retail Scanner and Consumer Panel (Kilts Center)
author_source: Kilts Center for Marketing, Chicago Booth, dataset, 2006-present, restricted licence
note: Weekly store-UPC prices and units from tens of thousands of US stores plus a household panel of 40,000-60,000 households; reference data for modern pricing research.
course_use: Faculty/PhD research only; institutional subscription and individual agreement; not for class distribution.

title: bayesm::camera conjoint data
author_source: Peter Rossi, CRAN bayesm v3.1-7, GPL, R dataset
note: CBC on digital cameras: 332 respondents x 16 tasks, 4 brands plus none; attributes brand, pixels, zoom, video, swivel, wifi, price.
course_use: Lab: MNL and HB-MNL, WTP for wifi or zoom, heterogeneity, share simulation. Free.

title: bayesm::margarine and bayesm::orangeJuice
author_source: Peter Rossi, CRAN bayesm, GPL, R datasets
note: margarine: household panel choices among 10 brands with prices and demographics (516 households). orangeJuice: Dominick's weekly store-level sales of 11 OJ brands in 83 stores with prices, deal, feature and store demographics.
course_use: Labs: brand-choice MNL with price (margarine); store-level log-log demand and elasticity heterogeneity by demographics (orangeJuice). Free.

title: mlogit datasets: Cracker, Catsup, Heating, Electricity
author_source: Yves Croissant, CRAN mlogit, GPL, R datasets
note: Cracker: 3,292 purchases of 4 brands by 136 households (price, display, feature). Catsup: 2,798 ketchup purchases. Heating: 900 households choosing systems by installation and operating cost. Electricity: stated choice of supplier with price, contract length, time-of-day rates.
course_use: Lab: brand-choice MNL with elasticities; Heating for WTP for operating-cost savings; Electricity for WTP for contract terms. Free.

title: conjoint::tea dataset
author_source: CRAN conjoint package, GPL, R dataset
note: 100 respondents rating 13 tea profiles on price, variety, kind, aroma (tprof, tpref, tlevn).
course_use: Intro part-worth and importance lab. Free.

title: logitr datasets: yogurt and cars_us
author_source: John Helveston, CRAN logitr, MIT, R datasets
note: yogurt: 2,412 purchases by 100 households among 4 brands with price and feature. cars_us: stated-choice conjoint on vehicle type, price, fuel economy, acceleration, powertrain, range.
course_use: Lab: WTP-space models for fuel economy and electric powertrain. Free.

title: AER datasets: CigarettesSW and Journals
author_source: Kleiber and Zeileis, CRAN AER, GPL, R datasets
note: CigarettesSW: US state panel of cigarette prices, taxes and packs (IV with tax as instrument). Journals: subscription prices and citations of 180 economics journals.
course_use: Lab: IV vs OLS demand elasticity with ivreg(). Free.

title: Inside Airbnb - Vienna
author_source: Inside Airbnb, portal, snapshot 17 Sep 2026, CC BY 4.0, CSV/GeoJSON
note: Vienna files: listings.csv.gz (nightly price, room type, district, capacity, reviews, superhost, amenities; roughly 12,000-14,000 listings), calendar.csv.gz (daily price and availability for a year), reviews.csv.gz, neighbourhoods.geojson. Quarterly snapshots.
course_use: Lab: hedonic price regression for Vienna (implicit WTP for location, size, superhost); calendar data for weekday/event pricing. Free, open licence.

title: The Economist Big Mac Index data
author_source: The Economist, GitHub, semi-annual updates, data CC BY 4.0 / code MIT, CSV
note: big-mac-raw-index.csv, big-mac-adjusted-index.csv, big-mac-full-index.csv (2000-present, about 50-70 countries): local_price, dollar_ex, dollar_price, GDP_dollar, adj_price, raw and GDP-adjusted indices vs USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY.
course_use: Lab on international pricing: relate local prices to GDP per capita (income-adjusted WTP). Free.

title: Eurostat HICP and Price Level Indices
author_source: Eurostat, portal, monthly/annual, CC BY 4.0, CSV/SDMX
note: HICP by COICOP (prc_hicp_midx, prc_hicp_manr) incl. Austria; price level indices (prc_ppp_ind) for food, clothing, restaurants, electronics across countries.
course_use: Lab: Austrian vs German/CEE price levels; international price corridors and grey imports. Free.

title: Statistik Austria Verbraucherpreisindex (VPI/HVPI) open data
author_source: Statistik Austria, data.statistik.gv.at and STATcube, monthly, CC BY 4.0, CSV
note: VPI 2020 (2020=100) with COICOP sub-indices; annual average reached 128.2 in 2025 (8.6% inflation in 2022).
course_use: Lab/discussion: category price increases and shrinkflation in Austria 2022-2025; price pass-through. Free.

title: ECB Data Portal
author_source: European Central Bank, portal, monthly, free reuse with attribution, CSV/API
note: HICP series, Consumer Expectations Survey inflation expectations, exchange rates; API access.
course_use: Context for pricing under inflation. Free.

title: OECD Data Explorer - prices and PPPs
author_source: OECD, portal, CC BY 4.0, CSV/API
note: CPI by category, comparative price levels and PPPs for OECD countries.
course_use: International price comparisons for a global pricing assignment. Free.

title: Open Prices (Open Food Facts)
author_source: Open Food Facts, listed on data.europa.eu, 2024-, ODbL, CSV/Parquet/API
note: Crowdsourced product-level supermarket prices with barcode, store, location and date across countries incl. Austria; links to product attributes.
course_use: Lab: price dispersion for identical barcodes across retailers and countries; private-label gaps. Free, open licence.

title: Kaggle: Retail Price Optimization (suddharshan)
author_source: suddharshan, Kaggle, dataset, licence see page, CSV
note: retail_price.csv: product-month demand and average unit price with competitor prices, freight, category and ratings (several hundred rows; exact schema not verified).
course_use: Lab: elasticity by category and revenue-maximising price vs competitors. Free with Kaggle login.

title: Kaggle: ride-hailing dynamic pricing dataset
author_source: Kaggle community dataset, CSV, licence see page
note: About 1,000 rides with Number_of_Riders, Number_of_Drivers, Location_Category, Customer_Loyalty_Status, Vehicle_Type, Expected_Ride_Duration, Historical_Cost_of_Ride; widely used in surge-pricing tutorials. Synthetic; exact Kaggle page not verified.
course_use: Lab: build a supply-demand surge multiplier; discuss fairness of dynamic pricing. Free with Kaggle login.

title: Kaggle: Uber and Lyft Cab Prices (Boston)
author_source: ravi72munde, Kaggle, dataset, CSV
note: About 690,000 price quotes from Uber and Lyft in Boston (Nov-Dec 2018) with surge multiplier, distance, product, plus weather.
course_use: Lab: surge pricing by time and weather; competitor price levels. Free with Kaggle login.

title: Online Retail II (UCI)
author_source: Daqing Chen, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0, XLSX
note: UK online gift retailer transactions 2009-2011 (about 1.07 million rows): Invoice, StockCode, Description, Quantity, InvoiceDate, Price, Customer ID, Country.
course_use: Lab: item price variation and quantity response; quantity discounts and country differences. Free.

title: Olist Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset
author_source: Olist, Kaggle, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, CSV (9 tables)
note: About 100,000 orders 2016-2018 with item price, freight value, category, review score, seller and customer location.
course_use: Lab: partitioned pricing (freight share), price vs reviews. Free with Kaggle login, non-commercial.

title: Instacart Market Basket Analysis
author_source: Instacart, Kaggle competition data, non-commercial terms, CSV
note: 3 million+ grocery orders from 200,000+ users with products, aisles, reorder flags; contains no prices.
course_use: Only for bundling/cross-selling context. Free with Kaggle login.

title: Avocado Prices (Hass Avocado Board via Kaggle)
author_source: Justin Kiggins / Hass Avocado Board, Kaggle, CSV
note: Weekly US retail scan data 2015-2018: AveragePrice, Total Volume, PLU volumes, bag sizes, type (conventional/organic), region (about 18,000 rows).
course_use: Lab: elasticity of conventional vs organic avocados by region. Free with Kaggle login.

title: Expedia Hotel Search (ICDM 2013)
author_source: Expedia via Kaggle; loader in choice-learn, dataset
note: About 10 million hotel impressions with price_usd, stars, review score, location score, promotion flag, click and booking.
course_use: Lab: conditional logit hotel choice, WTP for stars/reviews in USD. Free with Kaggle login or via choice-learn.

title: Swissmetro stated-preference data
author_source: Bierlaire/EPFL, distributed with Biogeme and choice-learn, free for research/teaching
note: 10,728 choices (1,192 respondents x 9 tasks) among train, Swissmetro, car with time, cost, headway.
course_use: Lab: WTP for travel-time savings; analogy to rail pricing (e.g. ÖBB). Free.

title: Harvard Dataverse: Consumer WTP for safer fish
author_source: Harvard Dataverse, 2024, replication dataset
note: Survey data on consumer WTP for safe fish (rohu, tilapia, pangasius).
course_use: Real WTP survey data for replicating valuation analysis. Free.

title: Purchase intention and WTP for circular beef (5 EU countries)
author_source: Zenodo via data.europa.eu, 2023, open licence
note: 5,246 food-buying consumers in 5 EU countries: purchase intention, WTP for circular beef, attitudes, demographics.
course_use: Lab: drivers of WTP premiums for sustainability claims. Free.

title: Experimental auction on consumer WTP (Zenodo)
author_source: Zenodo via data.europa.eu, 2024, open licence
note: Experimental auction results on consumer perception and WTP for a food product.
course_use: Discussion of incentive-compatible WTP (BDM, Vickrey) vs stated WTP. Free.

title: Google Trends
author_source: Google, web tool, free, CSV export
note: Search interest by region and time, e.g. 'Klimaticket', 'Preiserhöhung', streaming price increases in Austria.
course_use: Lab: consumer attention around price changes. Free.

title: data.gv.at incl. E-Control fuel prices and transport data
author_source: Austrian Federal Chancellery, portal, mostly CC BY 4.0, CSV/API
note: Austrian open data: Statistik Austria tables, E-Control fuel price API (Spritpreisrechner), ÖBB and Wiener Linien timetable data; fares mostly not available as datasets.
course_use: Lab: fuel price dispersion and time-of-day pricing across Austrian stations. Free.

title: Numbeo cost of living indices
author_source: Numbeo, crowdsourced portal, proprietary terms
note: Crowdsourced city prices (cappuccino, meal, transit pass, rent) and indices for Vienna and peers.
course_use: Quick price-level comparisons; not representative. Free web, API paid.
